author: rmgoshawa
title: Paid artist commission for gallery neighbourhood banners
content: Exciting news! Are you a community focused and engaged creative? We have an amazing opportunity for an artist or artist group to design a collaborative banner for The Robert McLaughlin Gallery and LivingRoom Community Art Studio's (@thelivingroomartstudio) Neighbourhood Project. You may have already participated in one of these community activations over the past year, and now is your chance to be further connected to this project. The selected design will be featured on a series of banners on an exterior wall of the RMG and on flags/banners for the LRCAS Mobile Art Hive Bus throughout the year. Design Proposal Submission Deadline: October 9th, 2026, 5PM. Artist(s) Selection Date: October 21, 2026. Artist(s) Fee/Commission: $2,500. Please visit the link in our bio or rmg.on.ca/opportunities for submission details. This project is generously supported by the Ontario Trillium Foundation.

author: asymptotejrnl
title: Asymptote seeking designers and guest illustrators
content: Asymptote is seeking designers and guest artists! Literature crosses borders through words—but every issue of Asymptote also needs a visual language of its own. We are looking for imaginative designers to join our international team, as well as guest artists interested in shaping the look and atmosphere of a single issue. Designers will help translate the journal’s literary vision into compelling visual form across our website, social media, newsletters, campaigns, and other digital materials. We are also inviting illustrators to collaborate with us on a single quarterly issue, working alongside our editorial team. Interested? Attach a cover letter to your portfolio and send an application to our editors@asymptotejournal.com inbox today!

author: wearereelfx
title: Reel FX hiring matte painting / environment artists
content: Let your talent run wild! Reel FX Animation is looking for Matte Painting Artists to work on wonderful environments for our 3D feature Doctor Dolittle: King of the Wild. Maya · Nuke · Photoshop · After Effects. Location: Montréal · 3 days/week in studio. Start date: ASAP. Apply today and show us your portfolio: https://careers.reelfx.com/apply/823?language=en
